cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

mechanism: A directs submitting a quiz solution and concedes a joint answer while turning identical and simultaneous deductions into a race decided by chalk and name order.
confusable: Unlike seeking a precise discovery-role attribution, A needs to win firstness even when the answer is shared; authority offers inclusion while retaining hierarchy.
comparison: A shared whodunit answer differs from controlling an office snack discovery announcement.
seedUse: D139-b identical conclusions, simultaneous speech and chalk timing grounded in a quiz; S02-b adjusts submission credit to retain B cooperation.
